name: Nerra Daily
description: Nerra Daily is the Nerra Network's combined daily edition. Every morning, once the day's English shows have published, Mira assembles them into one continuous listen — flagships first: Tesla Shorts Time, Models & Agents, SpaceX Daily and Modern Investing Techniques, then world news, science and the network's narrative shows, closing on The DP Pod's good news. On Mondays the weekly shows join the rundown. Every segment is the full, unabridged episode from that show's own feed; what Nerra Daily adds is the through-line — Mira's introductions, the connections between stories, and one place to hear it all. Subscribe to Nerra Daily for everything, or pick up any individual show from its own feed at nerranetwork.com.
